title: Homelab / Services
description: GitOps state, workload health, ingress traffic, Postgres and supporting services.

panels.title: Flux resources not ready
panels.description: Kustomizations, HelmReleases and sources that are failing. A HelmRelease stuck here means changes in git are not reaching the cluster.

panels.title: Suspended
panels.description: Suspended resources ignore git until resumed.

targets.expr: max by (kind, exported_namespace, name, ready, suspended, reason) (flux_resource_info{ready!="True"} or flux_resource_info{suspended="True"})
count((kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{reason="OOMKilled"} == 1) and on (namespace, pod, container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[24h]) > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Failed jobs
panels.description: Jobs (incl. CronJob runs) still present with failed pods.

panels.title: Clusters
panels.description: WAL archive age is the real backup heartbeat: if it stops advancing, point-in-time recovery is broken. Base backups run nightly.

panels.title: CoreDNS responses by code
panels.description: SERVFAIL spikes usually mean upstream DNS (1.1.1.1 / 8.8.8.8) is unreachable.
